newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to scrap UES investment fund.
newsitem.headline: Russia to scrap UES investment fund.

text.p: The Russian government plans to scrap an investment fund of power company Unified Energy Systems as part of its plan to restructure natural monopolies, Interfax news agency said on Monday, quoting minister Yevgeny Yasin.
Alexander Lopatin, a UES funds manager, told Reuters the company would be forced to either raise power tariffs or to draw funds through security issues.
"We see two options -- we will have to raise tariffs considerably, despite a decision to lower tariffs this year, or to raise money through issues of shares and bonds," he said.
He said yearly payments to the investment fund by regional utilities using UES networks amounted to about $1 billion.
The state owns 52.5 percent of the RAO Yedinaya Energeticheskaya Sistema Rossii (UES) and will hold 51 percent will be held by the government until December 31, 1998.
